title: Vikram and Betal: The Brave Boy
moral: Bravery comes from courage and intelligence.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a brave boy.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a brave boy from a village.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: A wild animal scares the village.
scenes.text: A wild animal entered the village and frightened everyone.
scenes.image_prompt: wild animal in village with people running away cartoon

scenes.text: The boy used noise and fire to scare the animal.
scenes.image_prompt: boy lighting fire and making noise to scare animal cartoon

scenes.text: The animal got scared and ran back into the forest.
scenes.image_prompt: animal running away into forest cartoon

scenes.text: Vikram said bravery comes from courage and intelligence. Betal flew away again.
scenes.image_prompt: betal flying away while vikram stands calm cartoon

story: A brave boy saved his village from a wild animal using intelligence and courage. Vikram said true bravery is smart thinking, and Betal flew away.
